title: Book with toString()
hints: The method signature must be exactly: public String toString()
Put @Override on the line above it. The compiler will then check that you really are overriding a method.
To put a double quote inside a String, escape it: "\"" is a String containing one " character.

mustContain.message: Override public String toString() in Book.
